name: Alexei Aguilar
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember a drummer trusting me with one wooden stick.” People around the steps at Pier Beach know Alexei by a small Thursday habit. Alexei watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: My grandmother made me sit on my hands at concerts. I climbed up and played her favorite rhythm.
appearance: Alexei has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Look for a loose dark braid. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a dark green knitted vest with a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial. In conversation Alexei listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Is a careful borrower and a reckless lender. Things leave this person's house with elaborate instructions and very little expectation of ever coming back.
agenda: To play the grandmother's rhythm without asking permission twice.
family: Neal Day is Alexei’s older cousin. Alexei puts the kettle on. Neal chooses the music. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The uniform money*, Neal says, “I showed up in a football shirt on my first day.”
connections: Billie Abbott. An audience volunteer receives the first paid booking.

reactions.situation: A child freezes halfway through the song
reactions.response: Alexei lets the beat drop out and waits for the child to choose whether to rejoin.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Alexei keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.

reactions.situation: If a stranger returns something damaged
reactions.response: Alexei listens first to the account of how it was actually used.
